scope: Document serialization structure; not architecture conformance, external semantic authority, or runtime evidence
crossDocumentIntegrity: Evaluated separately; JSON Schema alone does not prove cross-file referential integrity
jsonLdModel: A5 expanded JSON-LD, graph equivalence must be evaluated with RDF parser separately
m16AssessmentBoundary: HYBRID and ASSESSMENT cannot be automatically declared SATISFIED by schema validation
validationSemantic: Schema PASS proves only that the provided JSON instance meets the stated structural schema
